FRESH FOLD · SQLITE EDITION

Your laundry app.
Your own database.

The app now stores data in a free SQLite database on your computer or server. No Supabase account or database subscription is required.

GitHub Pages displays this information page. The working owner, rider and booking pages run together on your own server, which must stay on while you use the app.

Follow the setup guide →Download the appInstall Node.js 22.16+ (Monterey) or 24, extract the download, and open start.cmd on Windows or run ./start.sh on macOS/Linux. Public internet access needs separate hosting and HTTPS.
